nextStoryContext: US-002 is done: test/commands-freeze.test.ts hardcodes the 26-entry FROZEN_COMMANDS list (verified against the live index.ts COMMANDS array at commit time) and asserts both COMMANDS.length===26 and sorted-set equality against the frozen list. This is intentionally independent of test/help-registry.test.ts's existing relative parity checks (COMMANDS vs HELP_REGISTRY keys, COMMANDS vs switch-case labels), which would NOT catch a coordinated drop of an entry from COMMANDS+HELP_REGISTRY+switch together -- only a hardcoded frozen list does. US-003 (wire validate-agents-md as check:all gate #12) is unaffected by this story and can proceed independently.
